# Daclify

> Daclify V2 is a modular DAO platform in development, focused on membership, governance, funded work and encrypted documents.

This public website describes the vision and actual development status. V2 is not a qualified production release. Managed recovery, social/Telegram entry, complete independent deployments and EVM support remain unfinished or capability-gated. Basic governance is intended to be free within defined resource limits; final prices and launch dates are not announced.

Private V2 repositories are not public documentation. The Telegram community is at https://t.me/daclify.

## English

- [Daclify — Modular DAO governance for real communities](https://daclify.com/): Discover Daclify V2: a modular DAO platform for community decisions, funded work and encrypted documents. Explore the vision and development roadmap. Markdown: https://daclify.com/index.md
- [DAO platform, accounts and deployment choices | Daclify](https://daclify.com/platform/): Learn how Daclify V2 brings internal accounts, native wallets, DAO-owned contracts and Hub discovery into a modular governance platform. Markdown: https://daclify.com/platform/index.md
- [Decide, Works and payroll DAO modules | Daclify](https://daclify.com/modules/): Explore Daclify’s modular governance vision: Decide voting, Works milestone funding, payroll, shared documents and planned hosted Operations. Markdown: https://daclify.com/modules/index.md
- [Encrypted DAO documents and account custody | Daclify](https://daclify.com/privacy/): Understand Daclify’s privacy design: encrypted DAO documents, member key access, user-controlled or managed recovery, and the limits of public blockchains. Markdown: https://daclify.com/privacy/index.md
- [Daclify V2 development roadmap and release status](https://daclify.com/roadmap/): See what Daclify V2 implements today and what remains: contract verification, accounts, independent deployments, Pinata, EVM and hosted Operations. Markdown: https://daclify.com/roadmap/index.md
